name: plugged_guide
title: How to draw in Plugged
description: Read this first, once per conversation: how Plugged stores a project and how to turn a floor plan (a PDF, a photo, a sketch) into a situatieschema with the right symbols and circuit marks, so the user can make the eendraadschema from it.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: The projects of the user in Plugged (own ones and those shared with a group), newest first: id, name, last saved, whether they are his own.

name: get_project
title: Read a project
description: The whole project document (JSON) with its version, needed to change it with save_project. Large: read it only when you need the details.

name: list_symbols
title: List symbols
description: The symbols of the library of the user (AREI and IEC 60617 symbols and his own), with the key to use in draw_floor_plan or in a project document. where: 'plan' = symbols that can be placed on the situatieschema (sockets, switches, lights, appliances, ...), 'one_wire' = elements of the eendraadschema, 'wiring' = symbols of the bedradingsschema. search filters on key, name and category.

search.description: Optional words to look for, e.g. 'stopcontact' or 'licht'

name: create_project
title: New project
description: Makes a new, empty project of the user (a connection with kWh meter, main differential and a board on the eendraadschema, an empty plan). Answers its id and version.

name.description: Name in the project list, e.g. the address or the client

language.description: Language of the page names and of the default elements

title_block.description: Optional fields of the title block (Kaderinfo): straat, nr, postcode, gemeente, eigenaar, ean, tekenaar, rev, dossier, stelsel (e.g. '230V TT'), installatiedatum

name: draw_floor_plan
title: Draw floor plans
description: Draws one or more floors on the situatieschema of a project, in real metres (x to the right, y down, from the top left corner of the building): rooms as rectangles (their walls are drawn and their name is shown with the floor area), extra walls, doors, windows, passages, texts, and the electrical symbols with their circuit mark (e.g. 'B4' = point 4 of circuit B). Plugged picks the scale and centres the plan on the sheet. Read plugged_guide first. The previous version stays in the history of the project.

passages.description: Openings without a door: cut out of the room walls

mark.description: circuit letter(s) + point number, e.g. 'A3'. Everything with the same mark is one point (a switch and the lamps it switches)

size.description: mm on the sheet, 4 by default

area.description: show the floor area of the room the text is in (for rooms drawn with walls)

replace.description: Replace all pages of the situatieschema (else: added after them, or replacing them when they are empty)

make_one_wire.description: Ask the user, when he opens the project, to make the eendraadschema from the marked symbols

version.description: The version you read (get_project); refused when somebody saved since. Leave out to draw on the newest version.

rotation.description: 0 on a horizontal wall, 90 on a vertical wall

flip.description: door opens to the other side

name: save_project
title: Save a project document
description: Saves a whole project document (as read with get_project, changed), for changes draw_floor_plan cannot make, such as editing the eendraadschema tree or the title block. version must be the one you read: the save is refused when somebody saved since. The previous version stays in the history.
